data.title: 山田杏奈 · 夏日祭典木屐磨脚的长椅依靠·「木屐带子磨得脚好痛……市川，能让我靠一会儿吗」
data.description: 【神社夏祭烟花树下石阶长椅·夜】夏夜祭典穿浴衣的难耐时刻。山田穿着藏青色金鱼花纹浴衣，因为不习惯木屐脚跟被磨红，只得脱下一只木屐坐在树下石凳上。她有些难为情地把头轻轻靠在市川肩膀上，手里还拿着苹果糖，烟花在夜空中炸开，照亮她动情的侧颜。
data.action: 脱木屐揉脚踝，歪头依靠在身侧肩膀，烟花夜空下低语
data.lighting: 夜空烟花多重绚烂彩光与古树下纸灯笼
data.camera: medium full shot, seated view, shoulder contact, hands and exposed ankle visible
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada rests on a stone bench beneath an ancient cedar tree during the summer shrine fireworks festival, wearing an indigo yukata with white goldfish motifs. One wooden geta sandal has been slipped off beside the bench. She rubs the exposed ankle with one hand while holding a half-eaten candy apple in the other, leaning her head against the viewer's shoulder with a shy flush. Multicolored fireworks light her cheek and neck beauty mark, while paper lanterns illuminate the stone bench and removed sandal. A seated medium-full view keeps the shoulder contact, her hands and the exposed ankle together.
